p3_b0.ocr: As the demand for logistics services continues to surge across Europe, American Tower is strategically positioning itself to capitalize on this growth through the expansion of its logistics warehouse portfolio. The accompanying data table outlines key metrics related to this expansion initiative, including the size of each new facility measured in square meters (sqm) and associated costs in GBP.

p3_b1.ocr: The expansion aims to enhance our operational capacity and meet the increasing needs of our clients, particularly in urban areas where logistics efficiency is paramount. By investing in additional units, we aim to improve our occupancy rate, thereby ensuring a higher return on investment and maximizing asset utilization.
